## Context

This document has no H1 at all, which trips `h1`. With no H1 there is no Y-statement block-quote following it either,
so the `y-statement` warning fires too — that interaction is intentional and pinned by the golden.

## Decision

Trigger `h1` (error) and `y-statement` (warning), with all required sections present so nothing else fires.

## Alternatives Considered

* **Add an H1** — rejected: then this document would not test the missing-H1 path.

## Consequences

The golden records one error and one warning for this document.
